messages:
acme_procurement: Hey team — we received invoice INV-2024-9987 but the PO number is missing. Our AP team can’t post the payment to our ledger without PO 78945. Invoice is already paid on 2024-05-02 (payment ID PAY-4433). Can you add the PO to the existing invoice or advise next steps?

maria_support: Sorry about that — thanks for flagging. I can loop finance. Can you confirm the billed entity and the exact PO string you want on the invoice?

acme_procurement: Billed to Acme Corp (legal: Acme Holdings, tax ID: 12-3456789). PO should read PO-78945-ACME. We need the corrected invoice PDF for our vendor portal.

maria_support: Got it. Two standard options: (1) Retroactively update the invoice PDF to include the PO (fast, but some accounting systems don't accept a post-payment edit), or (2) issue a credit for the paid invoice and create a corrected rebill invoice that includes the PO — this is the safest for audit trail. For settled payments we typically do credit+rebill.

maria_support: @jason_finance can you confirm the internal steps and ETA for credit+rebill for a paid invoice? Also tagging @alice_billing for any system-level constraints.

jason_finance: I can take this. Quick checklist I’ll run: 1) verify payment status in billing ledger (payments.payments where id = 'PAY-4433') 2) check invoice metadata (invoices.meta ->> 'purchase_order' field) 3) create credit note for INV-2024-9987 and link to payment 4) create new invoice INV-2024-9987-R with PO-78945-ACME and apply payment allocation. If the payment has been reconciled in bank feed, we need a manual reallocation step in the AR system. ETA ~ end of day today.

alice_billing: FYI — our billing system does not allow editing a posted invoice number after settlement; credit+rebill is required unless finance approves a one-off PDF amendment. Also note VAT lines will be recalculated on the new invoice.

maria_support: Thanks. Two quick repro snippets for finance (internal):

- verify invoice/payment
```
SELECT i.id, i.status, i.meta->>'purchase_order' AS po, p.id AS payment_id, p.status
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.invoice_number = 'INV-2024-9987';
```

- create credit note (pseudo):
```
POST /internal/billing/credits
{ "invoice_number": "INV-2024-9987", "reason": "PO missing, customer requested rebill", "created_by": "jason_finance" }
```

maria_support: @acme_procurement we’ll proceed with credit+rebill unless you tell us to attempt a PDF amendment. Credit+rebill gives you a clean invoice with the PO and an audit trail — standard practice for customers doing PO-based accounting.

acme_procurement: Please do credit+rebill. We need the new invoice PDF emailed to ap@acme.example and the credit note for our records.

jason_finance: Acknowledged. Will: 1) generate credit note and post it, 2) create corrected invoice INV-2024-9987-R with PO-78945-ACME, 3) allocate the existing payment PAY-4433 to the new invoice and close the credit note. I’ll attach the PDFs when done.

billing-bot: Payment PAY-4433: status "Settled". Invoice INV-2024-9987: status "Paid".

maria_support: Thanks all — I’ll keep the customer updated. tagging ops in case reallocation needs manual bank reconciliation: @ops-payments.

jason_finance: Quick note for ops: if bank reconciliation already matched PAY-4433 to INV-2024-9987 in the ledger, please hold off on any automatic unreconciles until I confirm. I’ll post the credit+rebill and then request reallocation.

acme_procurement: Appreciate the quick help — please confirm when PDFs are ready. :thumbsup:
